Name: Stack Everything Redux
Author: thimadera
Description:
[center][size=5][color=#FFD921][b]📦 Stack Everything Redux for Stardew Valley 🌱[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[color=#59C9F1][b]Stack Everything Redux[/b][/color] is an awesome mod that supercharges your item stacking experience in [color=#59C9F1][i]Stardew Valley[/i][/color]! Say goodbye to clutter because now you can stack all sorts of items that normally don't stack, like [color=#90D26D]Furniture[/color], [color=#90D26D]Tackles[/color], and [color=#90D26D]Wallpapers[/color]. Not only that, you can go beyond the default limit of 999 by customizing the max stack amount in the mod's settings.
— But wait, there's more! This mod also introduces a handy input method ([b]SHIFT+Right Click[/b]) for easily selecting the amount you need when buying, crafting, cooking, or splitting stacked items. It's like magic for your inventory!

[b][size=4][color=#FFD921]Key Features:[/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*] [b][color=#59C9F1]Expanded Stacking Capability[/color][/b]: Stack items that are not stackable by default, including [color=#90D26D]Furniture[/color], [color=#90D26D]Tackles[/color], and [color=#90D26D]Wallpapers[/color]. Decorative cacti are excluded to preserve their unique appearances.
[*] [b][color=#59C9F1]Modify Default Max Amount[/color][/b]: Customize the default maximum stack amount beyond 999 for improved item management.
[*] [b][color=#59C9F1]Enhanced Input Selection[/color][/b]: Adds a convenient input method ([b]SHIFT+Right Click[/b]) to select desired amounts when buying, crafting, cooking, or splitting stacked items.
[*] [b][color=#59C9F1]Improved Tackle Handling[/color][/b]: Tackles now share durability correctly when stacked, and broken ones shift properly. A new config lets you disable tackle stacking if you prefer.
[*] [b][color=#59C9F1]Compatibility Fixes[/color][/b]: Improved behavior with shops, crafting/cooking, and chest menus (Better Chests support included).
[/list]
[b][size=4][color=#FFD921]Configuration Options:[/color][/size][/b]The [i]Stack Everything Redux[/i] mod offers versatile configuration options:
[list]
[*] [b][color=#59C9F1]MaxStackingNumber:[/color][/b] Set the maximum stack amount for every stackable item.
[*] [b][color=#59C9F1]DefaultCraftingAmount:[/color][/b] Specify the default amount for [b]SHIFT+Right Click[/b] in cooking/crafting menus.
[*] [b][color=#59C9F1]DefaultShopAmount:[/color][/b] Determine the default amount for [b]SHIFT+Right Click[/b] in shop menus.
[*] [b][color=#59C9F1]EnableStackSplitRedux:[/color][/b] Enable or disable Split Redux functionalities.
[*] [b][color=#59C9F1]EnableTackleSplit:[/color][/b] If enabled, tackles can stack and share durability. If disabled, tackles remain separate like vanilla.
[/list]
The [i]Stack Everything Redux[/i] mod integrates with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][color=#DDA059]Generic Mod Config Menu[/color][/url] for easy in-game configuration. You can also adjust settings by editing [i]config.json[/i] in the mod's folder.

[b][size=4][color=#FFD921]Localization:[/color][/size][/b]
English (default)
Portuguese (pt)
Chinese (zh)
Spanish (es)

[b][size=4][color=#FFD921]Note:[/color][/size][/b]
Certain items like tools, hats, rings, boots, and weapons remain unstackable due to technical constraints.

[b][size=4][color=#FFD921]Inspiration & Credits:[/color][/size][/b]
The development of [i]Stack Everything Redux[/i] was inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/44734342][color=#DDA059]CatCattyCat[/color][/url]'s "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2053][color=#DDA059]Stack Everything[/color][/url]" mod and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/27024274][color=#DDA059]pepoluan[/color][/url]'s "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8967][color=#DDA059]Stack Split Redux[/color][/url]" mod.
Special thanks to [color=#DDA059][url=https://www.kdau.com/]kdau[/url][/color] for the [url=https://www.kdau.com/scrollish][color=#DDA059]web app[/color][/url] used to create the banner image.

[b][size=4][color=#FFD921]Source Code:[/color][/size][/b]
The source code for [i]Stack Everything Redux[/i] is available on [color=#DDA059][url=https://github.com/thimadera/StardewMods/tree/master/StackEverythingRedux]GitHub[/url][/color] for transparency and community contributions. Feel free to explore, contribute, or fork the repository.

Your feedback is invaluable — happy farming! 🌾🐓
